external_entities.name: customer company
external_entities.description: A customer organization using the invoicing service as one tenant.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Each customer company is one tenant

external_entities.name: customer user
external_entities.description: A person at a customer company who uses the billing app as an admin or viewer.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Each user belongs to one company and is either an admin or a viewer.

external_entities.name: payer
external_entities.description: The recipient of an invoice email who can view the payment page.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Each invoice email sends the payer a link

external_entities.name: support agent
external_entities.description: A support employee who uses the admin console from the support office network.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our support agents work from the support office network.

processes.name: billing app
processes.description: The shared invoicing application used by customer users, which manages invoices, customer information, payout bank details, PDF requests, and payment pages.
processes.source_excerpt: all companies share one billing app
processes.notes: The text does not state whether invoice ownership is checked when an invoice is opened. It also does not state whether user roles are checked again when a request arrives.

processes.name: PDF renderer
processes.description: A renderer that consumes render jobs, reads invoices, and writes PDFs to the PDF bucket.
processes.source_excerpt: The PDF renderer takes jobs off the queue one at a time
processes.notes: The text does not state where the renderer runs.

processes.name: admin console
processes.description: A console used by support agents to open sessions in the billing app as customer users.
processes.source_excerpt: From the admin console an agent can open a session in the billing app as any customer user.
processes.notes: The console is reachable only from the support office network, but its running location is not stated.

data_stores.name: tenant database
data_stores.description: A shared PostgreSQL database containing every company's invoices, customers, and payout bank details, with a company ID column on every table.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The billing app keeps every company's invoices, customers and payout bank details in one PostgreSQL database, the tenant database.
data_stores.notes: The database has no row-level security. The billing app uses one database account for all companies. The text does not state how the database is protected at rest.

data_stores.name: render queue
data_stores.description: A queue carrying PDF render jobs containing a company ID and an invoice number.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The billing app puts a render job on the render queue.
data_stores.notes: The text does not state where the queue runs or how it is protected.

data_stores.name: PDF bucket
data_stores.description: A shared bucket storing rendered PDFs under a company ID and invoice number.
data_stores.source_excerpt: writes the PDF to the PDF bucket under the company ID and the invoice number
data_stores.notes: The billing app fetches PDFs with one service credential for all companies. The text does not state how the bucket is protected at rest.

data_flows.name: use billing app
data_flows.description: A customer user accesses the billing app, signs in, views invoices, and submits invoice edits.
data_flows.source_excerpt: People at a customer company use the billing app in their browser over HTTPS.
data_flows.authentication: email address and password; session cookie
data_flows.data_description: Invoices, customer information, payout bank details, and invoice edits

data_flows.name: query tenant database
data_flows.description: The billing app queries and updates the tenant database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The billing app adds the company filter to each query itself
data_flows.notes: The app saves every field received from the invoice edit form, including the paid flag and payout bank account.
data_flows.authentication: one database account for all companies
data_flows.data_description: Invoices, customers, payout bank details, company IDs, and invoice edits

data_flows.name: send invoice link
data_flows.description: The billing app sends a payer an invoice link ending in the invoice number.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Each invoice email sends the payer a link that ends in the invoice number.
data_flows.data_description: An invoice link containing the invoice number

data_flows.name: view payment page
data_flows.description: A payer accesses the payment page and views the invoice, company name, and bank details.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The payment page shows the invoice, the company's name and its bank details
data_flows.data_description: Invoice, company name, and company bank details

data_flows.name: enqueue render job
data_flows.description: The billing app places a render job on the render queue.
data_flows.source_excerpt: the billing app puts a render job on the render queue
data_flows.data_description: Company ID and invoice number

data_flows.name: pull render job
data_flows.description: The PDF renderer takes render jobs from the queue.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The PDF renderer takes jobs off the queue one at a time
data_flows.data_description: Company ID and invoice number

data_flows.name: read invoice
data_flows.description: The PDF renderer reads an invoice from the tenant database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: reads the invoice from the tenant database
data_flows.notes: The renderer trusts the company ID carried by the job.
data_flows.data_description: Invoice identified by company ID and invoice number

data_flows.name: write PDF
data_flows.description: The PDF renderer writes a rendered PDF to the PDF bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: writes the PDF to the PDF bucket under the company ID and the invoice number
data_flows.data_description: Rendered invoice PDF

data_flows.name: fetch PDFs
data_flows.description: The billing app fetches PDFs from the PDF bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The billing app fetches PDFs from the bucket with one service credential for all companies.
data_flows.authentication: one service credential for all companies
data_flows.data_description: Invoice PDFs

data_flows.name: use admin console
data_flows.description: A support agent signs in to and uses the admin console.
data_flows.source_excerpt: each agent signs in to it with their own account and a one-time code
data_flows.authentication: own account and a one-time code
data_flows.data_description: Administrative requests and customer-user session actions

data_flows.name: open customer session
data_flows.description: The admin console opens a billing-app session as a customer user at the agent's request.
data_flows.source_excerpt: From the admin console an agent can open a session in the billing app as any customer user.
data_flows.notes: The text does not state the mechanism used by the admin console to authenticate to the billing app.
data_flows.data_description: A session in the billing app as a customer user

trust_boundaries.name: customer company
trust_boundaries.description: The customer-company tenant boundary containing customer users.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Each customer company is one tenant

trust_boundaries.name: support office network
trust_boundaries.description: The network from which support agents work and the admin console is reachable.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Our support agents work from the support office network.

trust_boundaries.name: cloud platform
trust_boundaries.description: The cloud platform containing the shared billing app, tenant database, and PDF bucket.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: all companies share one billing app, one database and one PDF bucket in our cloud platform.
